title: Milk bowl
summary: Eat for 1d4 healing without spending an action in combat, or use for 3 Camp Supplies.

fields.Consume: Single use. Restores 1d4 HP and triggers on-heal effects. The pinned item’s behavior note reports no action cost to consume in combat.
fields.Acquisition: Found as loot or sold by traders.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
